definitions:
A number of places in the United States:
An unincorporated community in Choctaw County, Alabama.
A city, the county seat of Brown County, Illinois.
A township in Brown County, Illinois, in which the city is located.
An unincorporated community in Jefferson Township, Switzerland County, Indiana.
A census-designated place in Van Buren County, Iowa.
A city, the county seat of Montgomery County, Kentucky, named after Stirling, Scotland and a burial mound.
An unincorporated community in Gasconade County, Missouri.
A mountain in Haywood County, North Carolina, thought to contain silver (sterling silver), which turned out to be lead.
A village in Madison County, Ohio.
An unincorporated community in Muskingum County, Ohio.
A village in Crawford County, Wisconsin.
An unincorporated community in Choctaw County, Alabama.

blocks.text: Mount Sterling is an unincorporated community in Choctaw County, Alabama, United States. Mount Sterling was once a prosperous antebellum community, with an economy based on cotton and timber, but today little is left other than a few scattered houses. One church building, the Mount Sterling Methodist Church, is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Mount Sterling is a city in and the county seat of Brown County, Illinois, United States. The population was 2,006 at the 2020 census.
